Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Janardan Prasad Tripathi, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Siddharth Singh,
learned counsel for the informant and Sri Satendra Tiwari, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State respondents .
2.

This writ petition has been filed praying to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 16.06.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 247 of 2024, under Sections 376, 406, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Bhelupur, District Varanasi and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the Himanshu Dwivedi vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: 3. Vide order dated 05.08.2024 the matter was referred to the mediation centre.

4. Perused the office report and the settlement agreement dated 11.08.2024 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph 7 of the settlement agreement dated 11.08.2024.

The paragraph 7 is quoted as under:-
"7. The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That the parties have already settled the matter outside the court and this fact has been accepted by Nikita Kumari (respondent no. 3) in her counter affidavit/compromise filed before the Hon'ble Court, a photocopy of the same is being annexed and shall be a part of this settlement also, for kind perusal of this Hon'ble Court.
b) That the parties have decided to end their dispute and not to litigate any further in respect of the same.

c) That both the parties agree that they have bright future but due to the present case it will be in dark, so both the parties have amicably settled their dispute between them, before the respected persons of the family and now they want to live peacefully their life separately without any interference of each other.

d) That in view of the above, Nikita Kumari (respondent no. 3) shall have no objection in any manner whatsoever, if the Hon'ble Court pleases to allow the present Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 11025 of 2024.

sentences.text: e) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all civil and criminal cases (if any) filed by them against each other regarding present dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.
f) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also.
g) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse."

5. It is submitted that as between the parties compromise had already taken place therefore, the impugned First Information Report dated 16.06.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 247 of 2024,
under Sections 376, 406, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Bhelupur, District Varanasi is liable to be Himanshu Dwivedi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28517354/
2 quashed.

sentences.text:
6. At this stage, learned AGA pointed out that in the present case charge-sheet has been forwarded on 05.08.2024.
7.

While granting the interim protection vide order dated 15.07.2024, we have noted the submissions made before this Court in paragraph-3, which is being quoted hereinbelow;
"3.

It is submitted that admittedly the informant was having relationship with the petitioner since the year 2017 and had admittedly gone to several places including Hotel and continued with physical relationship.
Now after about 7 years, present FIR was lodged with malafide intention to extract money as now the petitioner has appointed as Nayad Tehshildar.
Submission is that no offence under Section 376 is made out and informant is major aged about 32 years.
It is further submitted that money taken by the petitioner from the informant had also returned by means of cheque sent through registered post.
A photo copy of which is annexed as Annexure 4 to the writ petition.

Submission is that this is nothing but a malafide intent to extract money from the petitioner after his appointment as Government Officer and the same is liable to be quashed."
8.

In our order dated 05.08.2024, while referring the matter to the mediation centre, we also recorded that there was long standing relationship between the parties since 2017 and parties have entered into compromise, therefore, offence under Section 376 IPC is not made out.

9. In such view of the matter and on reading of the first information report as well as compromise that has taken place between the parties due to long standing consented relationship, the offence under Section 376 IPC is not made out.

8. Thus, in view of the well settled principles of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2003(4) SCC 675 (B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana), J.T. 2008(9) SC 192 (Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of investigation and another), (2012) 10 SCC 303 (Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab),
(2014) 9 SCC 653 (Yogendra Yadav and others Vs. State of Jharkhand) and also (2014) 6 SCC 466 (Narendra Singh Vs. State of Punjab), and in view of the settlement agreement dated 11.08.2024,
the First Information Report dated 16.06.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 247 of 2024, under Sections 376, 406, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Bhelupur, District Varanasi including the charge-sheet dated 15.07.2024 and all consequential proceeding are hereby quashed.
